event_name: RAP becomes default route for accessing UKB data
control_change: shift from local or mixed access toward Research Analysis Platform by default with limited exemptions
treatment_definition: projects or researchers first accessing after RAP-default date versus before; high-granularity access moved into controlled platform
candidate_controls: older UKB projects; projects exempt from RAP; comparable biobanks without RAP-default change

event_name: Policy that insurance companies can no longer directly access UKB data

candidate_controls: other commercial projects not in insurance; noncommercial projects; other biobanks
